question_type_overrides.technical: Prefer implementation details, service boundaries, controls, and architecture evidence.
question_type_overrides.security: Prefer certified controls, policy statements, audit evidence, and ownership.
question_type_overrides.staffing: Prefer approved biographies, role descriptions, availability assumptions, and delivery model evidence.
question_type_overrides.commercial: Never invent pricing, commercial commitments, or legal terms. Always flag gaps.
